turns.user_utterance: My card just got rejected at the checkout! I need this fixed now!
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—was the payment showing as “declined” at checkout, or did it show as “not recognised”/no response? Also, are you trying to pay online or in-store (card present)?

turns.user_utterance: It showed as declined, and I was trying to pay in‑store.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—if it was declined in-store, the most likely issue is a card payment being rejected. First, please confirm you have enough available balance and that the card is set up for in-store payments. If everything looks fine, try again with a different card/contactless method (chip vs tap). If it still declines, I can help check whether there’s a temporary restriction or the merchant may be triggering a security check—what country/merchant type was it (e.g., grocery, fuel, online terminal), and did you use contactless or chip?
